summary: Practise field observations, GROW safety conversations and SBI feedback. Explore the five-day course and build usable coaching outputs.
lede: Safety coaching helps supervisors and safety teams discuss control use and barriers during routine work and changing conditions. For frontline supervisors, safety officers and operational team leads, the course develops field observation, respectful questioning, GROW conversations and SBI feedback to explore task conditions and agree practical next steps. It also covers using Job Safety Analysis in discussion and recording follow-up actions without reducing coaching to a checklist.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who coach, observe or mentor people carrying out safety-critical work, from frontline operations through safety leadership.
audience: Incident Investigators using worker accounts to identify
prerequisites: Working familiarity with workplace hazards, safety controls and routine safety procedures is expected. No coding or programming is required.
